description: Arrange up to 9 photos into a beautiful mood-board collage with a title — perfect for design inspiration.

faqs.a: The board is 1200 × 900 px PNG. Images are cover-cropped to fill their tiles so the board always looks full.
faqs.q: What size is the mood board?

faqs.a: It adapts: 1 photo fills the board, 2–9 photos use a balanced grid layout.
Yes — everything happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Click "Choose images" and select up to 9 photos.
Type a board title and pick a background color.
Click "Download board" to save the PNG.
title: Mood Board Maker
